about: Machine-readable copy of https://nether.wiki/matrix/homeservers/ for Matrix clients. Keep it in step with the table on that page. registration: open | token | invite. calls: the server has MatrixRTC (LiveKit) voice/video set up.

servers.summary: Small 18+ community: creatives, intellectuals, psychonauts, furries.
servers.registration_note: Ask an existing member for an invite.

servers.summary: Solid general-purpose server, running since about 2017. Germany.
No ads or tracking. Deletes messages after about 180 days.
Privacy and tech crowd, with many bridges to other networks.
servers.registration_note: Asks for a registration token, a real email and a captcha. No VPN/Tor sign-ups.
The token is published on their rules page. No VPN sign-ups.
Ask in their Telegram info channel; entry is approved by hand.
